source._comment: Iowa SoS publishes 'Absentee Ballot Statistics' as a persistent PDF by county AND party (requested / issued / received, plus receipt method): https://sos.iowa.gov/elections/pdf/<YEAR>/general/AbsenteeCounty<YEAR>.pdf . 'Received' (returned) by party = ballots cast. This is a VALIDATABLE persistent file (the 2024 file is still up) that can be upgraded to a real pypdf parser like LA/MD. Staged as a skeleton for now (reads 0 until the 2026 file posts); requires pypdf when wired.
